original_text: Worker observed operating forklift without seatbelt in warehouse zone B.
A heavy wrench dropped from the scaffolding on level 3 and landed two feet away from a technician. No injuries.
Small crude oil leak detected at valve V-102. Approximately 5 gallons spilled into secondary containment.
Operator slipped on wet stairs and sprained ankle while descending from the main deck.
Pressure relief valve on tank 4 failed to open during routine testing.
Exposed electrical wiring found near the water pump on the eastern rig.
Crane load swung unexpectedly due to high winds
